judgment.rationale: The report demonstrates high fidelity to the provided evidence. It correctly identifies the technical capabilities and limitations of the NLP/LLM candidate for DDoS detection, citing the benchmark success (AE01S_6E6099FA4C2D13D4) and the production-deployment gaps (AE01C_A6798E23EEB1E487). It accurately applies the CIS IG2 organizational context and acknowledges the lack of jurisdiction-specific evidence for the Republic of Korea. Crucially, it preserves forecast modalities, correctly noting that the NLP/LLM state is measured by publication activity (NoP) and identifying a direct contradiction between the historical increasing trend (E_33_ADC8BC66D812799F) and the forecasted decreasing direction. It also correctly observes that the DDoS evidence focuses on bandwidth and vectors rather than incident frequency (NoI). All financial and budget constraints are explicitly acknowledged as unevC
